title: Generation of mouse hippocampal neural precursor cell lines with CRISPR/Cas9-mediated gene knockouts
protocol: Reconstitute oligonucleotides in ddH2O to 100 μM.
Phosphorylate and hybridize reconstituted oligonucleotides.
Incubate the reaction in a thermocycler for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Incubate the reaction for 5 minutes at 95°C.
Ramp down temperature from 95°C to 25°C at 5°C per minute.
Dilute hybridized oligonucleotides 1:250 in ddH2O to obtain an 80 nM sgRNA solution.
Prepare the restriction and ligation reaction in a 200 μL PCR tube.
Incubate the reaction for 6 cycles at 37°C for 5 minutes each cycle.
Incubate the reaction at 23°C for 5 minutes after each cycle of 37°C incubation.
Transform 50 μL of competent E. coli with 3 μL of the ligation reaction.
Follow the heatshock protocol as described in the manufacturer’s manual.
Plate transformed cells onto LB agar plates containing 100 mg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the plates for 12–16 hours at 37°C.
Pick a single bacteria colony into 3 mL of LB medium with 100 mg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the bacterial culture for 12–16 hours at 37°C and 200 rpm.
Isolate plasmids from 1 mL of the bacteria culture using GeneJET Plasmid Miniprep Kit or other commercial kits.
Perform Sanger sequencing using a primer targeting the U6 promoter.
Align Sanger sequencing trace with the expected sgRNA sequence.
Inoculate 250 mL of LB containing 100 mg/mL ampicillin with 0.5 mL of the remaining bacterial culture containing the validated sgRNA plasmids.
Incubate for 14 hours at 37°C and 200 rpm.
Isolate plasmids using GeneJET Endo-free Plasmid Maxiprep Kit or other commercial kits including an endotoxin-removal step.
Resuspend plasmids in sterile ddH2O.
Determine DNA concentration of the isolated plasmids.
Transfect neural precursor cells with the respective plasmids pX459+sgRNA.
Select transfected cells using puromycin treatment.
Plate selected cells at single-cell density to establish clonal cell lines.
Culture cells for approximately 48 hours until they reach 60% confluence.
Perform a half-medium change by removing 3 mL of proliferation medium.
Replace the removed medium with 2.5 mL of fresh proliferation medium.
Prepare dilution 1: mix Optimem reduced serum medium with 8 μL P3000 Reagent and 15 μg of plasmid to reach a volume of 250 μL.
Prepare dilution 2: mix 240 μL Optimem reduced serum medium with 10 μL Lipofectamin.
Add dilution 1 to dilution 2, mix by brief vortexing and incubate for 15 minutes at 20°C–23°C.
Add the transfection mix to cells, swirl plate.
Incubate the cells with the transfection mix for 36 hours in a cell culture incubator.
Prepare selection medium: add 2 μg/mL puromycin to proliferation medium.
Replace proliferation medium with selection medium and incubate for 24 h in a cell culture incubator.
Remove selection medium from cells, wash once with PBS.
Resuspend cells in 10 mL of wash medium, pellet for 5 min at 300 × g.
Remove supernatant, resuspend cells in 10 mL proliferation medium.
Determine cell concentration using a Neubauer chamber.
Dilute 500 cells in 30 mL proliferation medium containing 2 μg/mL heparin to achieve an approximate cell dilution of 16.7 cells/mL.
Mix cell suspension and distribute into an uncoated 384-well-plate (75 μL/well).
Incubate for 14 days in a cell culture incubator to allow neurosphere formation.
Add heparin to stabilize growth factors, allowing medium changes to be unnecessary during the incubation period.
Quantify cells accurately and dilute properly to avoid obtaining mixed clonal lines due to high concentrations or reducing neurosphere numbers due to low concentrations.
Optional: Freeze or expand as a mixed population the cells that were not plated after single-cell plating for gene editing efficiency testing.
Test editing efficiency using methods such as the SURVEYOR assay or PCR and sequencing.
Obtain clonal monolayer cultures of hippocampal neural precursor cells by dissociating single neurospheres and expanding them as monolayers.
Observe all wells of the 384-well-plate.
Label the wells that contain neurospheres.
Transfer individual neurospheres into single wells of a poly-D-lysine/laminin-coated 96-well-plate using a 100 μL-pipet.
Dissociate neurosphere in the 96-well by gently pipetting up and down 10 times.
Passage cells from the 96-wells into a 6-well-plate when they reach 80% confluence.
Split cells from the 6-well plate when they reach 80% confluence.
Freeze 0.5 million cells.
Resuspend 50,000–100,000 cells in lysis buffer suitable for analysis of genomic DNA.
Isolate genomic DNA from harvested cells using QIAamp DNA Micro Kit as outlined in the manufacturer’s manual.
Amplify genomic sequence flanking the target region using Phusion High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase and the respective genotyping primers.
Run 20 μL of each PCR product mixed with 4 μL of 6× loading dye on an 1% agarose gel.
Analyze the gel and confirm single bands.
Purify the remaining PCR product using QIAGEN PCR purification kit or other techniques.
Perform Sanger sequencing of the PCR product.
Align the obtained sequence to the reference sequence of the respective mouse gene.
